Welcome to heirowLLM Web Chat

        
Your browser is connected to this Workstation. Projects group sessions, Files hold session attachments, and model/runtime choices stay on this machine.

        

            
1. Sign inUse your heirowLLM account. SocketJack.com accounts work here; permissions are assigned by this Workstation.

            
2. Choose a projectOpen Projects to organize chats. Start New with Context when you want a clean session that keeps selected context.

            
3. Add files or imagesAttach beside the composer. Permission requests remain visible and require approval.

            
4. Pick a modelThe model list reflects what is downloaded and enabled on the Workstation Models tab.
